description: Replay optional events and find what rests on one named evidence item, reading stream or caveat. Use for impact inspection; caveat_explain instead explains all decisions and their reasons. Subjects are causes only: evidence, a reading stream or a caveat. Claims and decisions are never subjects, because a claim causes nothing and the grounds of a decision are evidence, not claims; both appear in the report as what the subject reaches. To trace from a claim, query the evidence that supports or opposes it (report.claims lists those relations). report (caveat-dependents/0.1) includes subject, kind, sequence, event outcomes, claims, decisions, changes, values, displayed values and withdrawal records; dependency entries distinguish grounds from possible influence through lineage. exitCode: 0 replay completed (may include rejected events); 1 fatal event with last good state; 2 load failure or unknown subject, with report.error. Returns the same JSON in structuredContent and text: {schema:"caveat-authoring/0.1",operation,sourceSha256,runtime,exitCode,report}. Read exitCode even when isError is false. Bridge failures instead set isError:true with {schema:"caveat-authoring-error/0.1",error:{kind,message}}.

events.description: Events replayed in array order from a fresh session. Omitted or [] inspects the initial state; previous calls supply no history. Rejections are recorded and replay continues; a fatal event stops replay at the last good snapshot. At most 1,000 entries and 1 MiB of serialized UTF-8 JSON.

items.description: One event to dispatch to the supplied program, for example {"event":"read","payload":{"value":85}} when source declares read with a value parameter.

event.description: Event name declared in source, such as read or assess. Supply the name only, without Caveat syntax.

payload.description: Values keyed by the event parameter names declared in source, for example {"value":85}. Omit for an empty payload ({}). The runtime checks parameter names, types and declared bounds.

source.description: Complete inline Caveat program text, available as the virtual file inline.cav. No file path or URL lookup. At most 1 MiB of UTF-8 source; each call uses a fresh runtime.

subject.description: Exact case-sensitive evidence name, reading stream name, caveat name, or evidence occurrence ID after replay. Evidence records supplied observations; a reading stream is a named history of samples; a caveat is a qualification on evidence. For example, probe selects its evidence/readings, values selects a stream, and values@1 selects one recorded reading. Use a name from source or caveat_explain; not a file path. A claim or decision name is refused like an unknown name, with exitCode 2.

name: caveat_dependents
